title: HomeFlood Written Claim Denials
content:
Tidemark denies a coverage on a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies claim in writing, with one stated reason from this list:

| Denial reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| not a flood event | the loss was not caused by flood |
| no coverage on date of loss | no coverage applied on the date of loss, including a loss inside the waiting period or a lapse |
| proof of loss not timely | the proof of loss was not received in time |
| excluded property | the property is excluded |
| loss below deductible | the loss does not exceed the deductible |

**Partial denials.** A partial denial covers only the denied coverage. A denial of personal property, for example, leaves the dwelling coverage on the same claim to be settled on its own.

**Contents of the letter.**
- It states that suit may be filed within the tier's suit limitation period, in calendar months, after the date of the denial.
- Where the tier makes appraisal available, it states that a disagreement on the amount of loss may go to appraisal.
